\caption{Applicability domain and calibration on the 22 official TDC ADMET Benchmark Group splits, for a fixed reference model (random forest, 300 trees, on Morgan radius-2 2048-bit fingerprints plus RDKit 2D descriptors) fitted to 80\% of each train\_val partition, with the remaining 20\% used only for conformal calibration. Coverage is the fraction of test compounds inside the domain. The error ratio is the mean test error outside the domain divided by that inside it (MAE for regression, 0/1 error for classification); values above 1 mean the domain flag separates worse predictions. ``Std.'' is the Roy standardization approach on RDKit descriptors; ``kNN'' is the 5-nearest-neighbour Tanimoto distance thresholded at the 95th percentile of training distances; ``Reliability'' is the conformal-interval-width flag (regression) or the posterior-probability confidence flag with $|p_1-p_0|\ge 0.5$ (classification). Conformal coverage is the empirical test coverage of 90\% split-conformal intervals or prediction sets. ``---'' marks a ratio not reported because fewer than five test compounds fall on one side of the domain boundary. Results describe the reference model, not the benchmark's selected model; single seed.}\label{tab:s8}\\
